features: Fixes projection renderer so applied screen format changes the actual canvas instead of remaining hard-coded to 9:16
Real and Test projection canvases now scale to 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 16:10, 21:9, 32:9, 1:1 or Custom aspect ratios
Adaptive grid uses ProjectionLayoutService columns and screen ratio in the rendered output
Adds competitor grid projection to the general projection renderer
Makes Real Live Screen Projector event-centric: select Event first, then Category and Round
Makes Test Live Screen Projector follow the same Event then Category then Round hierarchy
Event selection includes non-archived competition rounds so an operator deliberately controls which event is projected
Projection context remains locked to the selected event round for Judges, Competitors, Scoring, Callbacks, Finalists and Winners
No scoring calculation, results or official BDC points logic changed
No Staging or Production deployment performed
